Question: "Get the concerts held in 2020."
: 
SELECT concert_Name 
FROM concert 
WHERE Year = 2020; '''

Question: "Find the names and ages of students with pets older than 5 years."
: 
SELECT Student.Fname, Student.LName, Pets.pet_age 
FROM Student 
JOIN Has_Pet ON Student.StuID = Has_Pet.StuID 
JOIN Pets ON Has_Pet.PetID = Pets.PetID 
WHERE Pets.pet_age > 5; '''

Question: "Find the models of cars made by Ford."
: 
SELECT model_list.Model 
FROM model_list 
JOIN car_makers ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id 
WHERE car_makers.Maker = 'Ford'; '''

Question: "Get all flights operated by the airline 'Delta'."
: 
SELECT flights.FlightNo 
FROM flights 
JOIN airlines ON flights.Airline = airlines.uid 
WHERE airlines.Airline = 'Delta'; '''

Question: "Get all employees who work at the shop 'BestBuy'."

SELECT employee.Name 
FROM employee 
JOIN hiring ON employee.Employee_ID = hiring.Employee_ID 
JOIN shop ON hiring.Shop_ID = shop.Shop_ID 
WHERE shop.Name = 'BestBuy';

Question: "List all documents created using template version 2.0"

SELECT documents.Document_Name, documents.Document_Description 
FROM documents 
JOIN templates ON documents.Template_ID = templates.Template_ID 
WHERE templates.Version_Number = 2.0;

Question: "List all players with their ranking points as of January 2024."

SELECT players.first_name, players.last_name, rankings.ranking_points 
FROM players 
JOIN rankings ON players.player_id = rankings.player_id 
WHERE rankings.ranking_date = '2024-01-01';

Question: "List all players with their ranking points as of January 2024."

SELECT players.first_name, players.last_name, rankings.ranking_points 
FROM players 
JOIN rankings ON players.player_id = rankings.player_id 
WHERE rankings.ranking_date = '2024-01-01';

Question: "Get the list of courses offered in the 'Spring 2025' semester."

SELECT courses.course_name, courses.course_description 
FROM courses 
JOIN sections ON courses.course_id = sections.course_id 
JOIN semesters ON sections.semester_id = semesters.semester_id 
WHERE semesters.semester_name = 'Spring 2025';

Question: "List all TV series aired by channel 'ABC' in 2024."

SELECT tv_series.Episode, tv_series.Air_Date, tv_series.Rating 
FROM tv_series 
JOIN tv_channel ON tv_series.Channel = tv_channel.id 
WHERE tv_channel.series_name = 'ABC' AND YEAR(tv_series.Air_Date) = 2024;

Question: "List all poker players with their best finish and earnings."

SELECT people.Name, poker_player.Best_Finish, poker_player.Earnings 
FROM poker_player 
JOIN people ON poker_player.People_ID = people.People_ID;

Question: "List all orchestras and their conductors."

SELECT orchestra.Orchestra, conductor.Name 
FROM orchestra 
JOIN conductor ON orchestra.Conductor_ID = conductor.Conductor_ID;

Question: "List all friends of a given student (e.g., student with ID 1)."

SELECT h.name 
FROM Friend f 
JOIN Highschooler h ON f.friend_id = h.ID 
WHERE f.student_id = 1;

Question: "Find the charges for treatments or services."

SELECT charge_type, charge_amount FROM Charges;

Question: "List all songs along with their sales and highest chart position."

SELECT Title, Sales, Highest_Position FROM song;

Question: "List all features available for properties."

SELECT feature_name FROM Other_Available_Features;
